name: comp-230
title: Combobox With Action
description: A labelled picker over a couple of organisations, with a search field, a tick on the current one and a New organization action below a divider. Choosing a row closes the panel and fills the trigger.
use: When a picker needs a short list and a quick way out to create the item that is missing.
avoid: Typing hides the New organization row while filtering, so the create action vanishes exactly when it may be needed.
a11y: The trigger is a labelled combobox and filtering works from the keyboard; the New organization row is a plain button, so its keyboard order is unclear. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A small label sits above a wide rounded trigger reading coss.com with a chevron. Opened, a dark popover holds a search field, two short organisation rows with a tick on the first, a thin divider and a full-width New organization row with a plus.
behaves: Clicking the trigger opens the panel; typing filters the rows on each keystroke, and choosing one closes it and writes the name into the trigger. The clip types cr and ends on Cruip.
customise: The two organisations sit in an array in the file; swap them for your own names and values. The action row, its plus icon and the search placeholder are written there too.
weight: light: Two text rows plus one action in a popup with a short open animation.
